0022600001.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Celtics on the road against the Pistons. Boston is without Devin Carter, who is out with illness, while Detroit's Taurean Prince is day-to-day with a personal reason and is a game-time decision. The Celtics lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, and their most recent meeting was a 104-103 loss in Detroit on January 19, 2026, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives Boston a 50% chance of winning.
